sources.snippet: pi0.5 LIBERO dense contact action-frame yaw 10 adaptation Final step 9999 of 10,000 updates of cumulative-average H=10 IDM and base-image/wrist-image/prompt representation KD (weights 1/1/0.25). The entire policy, including the action expert, is trained. Global IDM and KD batches are 32, learning rate is 1e-5 with 500 warmup steps, and FSDP uses 4 GPUs. sources.title: The open-source vision-language-action model pi05_libero_finetuned ...
sources.snippet: This model, derived from the Pytorch conversion script of openpi and their pi05_libero model, has been fine - tuned for 6k steps on 8x H100 GPUs. π₀.₅ is a Vision - Language - Action model with open - world generalization, from Physical Intelligence. The LeRobot implementation is adapted from their open - source OpenPI repository.
